title: Advancing Coding in Low-Resource Programming Languages: What OpenAI's COBOL Benchmark Does Not Measure
description: OpenAI reports 97.9% on a COBOL migration evaluation requiring byte-for-byte output parity. Passing it does not settle which decisions must survive the rewrite.
og_headline: OpenAI's COBOL Benchmark: Parity Is Not Approval
og_alt: OpenAI's COBOL migration benchmark: behavioral parity is not approval of what survives modernization.

reciprocal.desc: Output parity proves a rewrite matches the old system, not what it must keep.
